name: Devil’s Food Cake II
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Melt chocolate over hot water, add one-half cup sugar, and gradually sweet milk; then add yolk of egg, and cook until mixture thickens.
Cream the butter, add gradually one-half cup sugar, egg well beaten, sour milk, and flour mixed and sifted with soda.
Bake in shallow cake pans, and put between and on top boiled frosting.
Add to filling one-fourth cup raisins seeded and cut in pieces, if desired.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
